iteration.new_gap: False-Saturation Class: a coarse channel with alpha <= 0 is reported as the census closing, while a finer channel's alpha stays high. Kill would differ (the finer channel is already inside the same likelihood). Queued. Not minted.

ranked.kill_rule: If the remainder channel is saturated (discovery coefficient alpha <= 0, or a nested rarefaction slope ~ 0), the instance leaves RGC.
ranked.legal: Research-stage classification. Not a physical discovery, not peer review, not a patent. Timestamp is not filing.
ranked.not_owned: DPC owns denom privilege. FCC owns which frontiers coincide. False-Saturation (coarse alpha <= 0 reported as census closure while a finer channel still climbs) is queued, not minted.

primary.named_object: isolate genomes and MAGs (17.8% of bacterial species-level diversity; 24.6% of archaeal)
primary.notes: DPC already owns treating the discoverable set as the 'all microbes' denominator. RGC owns the derivative: marginal samples add unbinned species faster than they add genomes. Spoken as a result inside this paper (0.50), not as a cross-realm class. 10 undescribed archaeal and 145 undescribed bacterial phyla are a stock, not the derivative.
primary.quantity: discoverable vs genomically represented prokaryotic species
primary.remainder_object: species-level clades hidden in unbinned contigs (~705,000 bacterial; ~27,000 archaeal)
primary.source: Prasoodanan, Maistrenko, Fullam, Mende, Kartal, Coelho, Spang, Bork & Schmidt, Nature Microbiology 11, 1437–1449 (2026). DOI 10.1038/s41564-026-02314-6. 92,187 metagenomes; 502 million marker-gene sequences. Unbinned discovery outpaces MAG discovery (alpha >= 0.5 across most habitats; soils, wetlands, rhizosphere, freshwater, non-mammalian guts alpha >= 0.8). Authors: the gap between discovered and discoverable 'will continue to widen.'

ranking.named_object: 20 copepod species plus 1 genus identified from the examined tenth
ranking.notes: single_bin_novelty only. The derivative across the remaining 90% has not been measured. Workshop identification is not a Code-published description. Not a stock-status finding and not proof that the next tenth will also be 100% new. Ranked below the measured alpha gap.
ranking.quantity: harpacticoid copepods from Mar del Plata Canyon, workshop identifications
ranking.remainder_object: the unexamined 90% of the collected harpacticoid samples
ranking.source: Nippon Foundation–Nekton Ocean Census press release, 1 Oct 2026, https://oceancensus.org/press-release-57-new-marine-species-discovered-in-argentinas-submarine-canyons/ . Workshop 13–24 July 2026, Universidad Maimónides, Buenos Aires, on Schmidt Ocean Institute Falkor (too) samples from the July–August 2025 Mar del Plata Canyon expedition. Quote: examined just 10% of collected copepod samples; every specimen examined was a species new to science; 20 new species and 1 new genus. Workshop total 57 species and 5 genera.

ranking.named_object: archaeal species in proGenomes3 and GTDB r220 recoverable by current metagenomic approaches
ranking.notes: Must score near zero. Saturation of this channel fires the kill. Do not confuse it with unbinned alpha, which the same paper says stays higher — that misreading is queued False-Saturation, not an RGC hit.
ranking.quantity: metagenomic representation of archaea already in reference genome sets, host habitats
ranking.remainder_object: additional archaeal species those approaches would add in infant gut, oral, skin
ranking.source: Same paper, Nature Microbiology 11, 1437–1449 (2026). Genome-based archaeal discovery fully saturated (alpha <= 0) or approaching saturation in most host-associated and anthropogenic habitats. Adding more samples is not expected to increase metagenomic representation of that reference-recoverable set in human infant gut, oral, or skin.

ranking.named_object: species already on a saturated accumulation curve
ranking.notes: Must score near zero. RGC is not the rediscovery of rarefaction.
ranking.quantity: textbook species-accumulation curve that has reached a plateau
ranking.remainder_object: expected new species at the terminal sample (slope ~ 0)
ranking.source: Gotelli & Colwell, and the standard rarefaction / Chao asymptote machinery. Method namesake retrieved as the kill definition, not as a 2026 census. A flat terminal slope is the kill, not an instance.
